metadata.title: The Mirrors - Complete Conceptual Card Catalog

setup.knowledge_slots: 4 slots unlocked at 1 total Sigil, 3 different colors, 3 matching colors, and 5 different colors; unlock permanently when achieved
setup.courage: Each placement +1 Courage; proposed adjacency implementation: choose one touching piece; matching color +1, different color +2; no neighbors +0. This interpretation is provisional.

caveats: All individual effects are proposed and require playtesting.
White Mirror discovery family counts and spell Element costs are mathematically verified.
Learning Element tokens are assumed spent; Tool is not consumed (provisional).
Quick Sigils exhaust and refresh at start of owner next turn (provisional).
Permanent Sigils remain on the card; disposal/recovery when leaving a Spell is deferred.
Occuldor arrival punishment: only heroes in room entered; Black Mirror curse: only hero flipping.
Black Mirror can never stop corresponding fragment restoration even if it causes death or movement (provisional).
Room objects accessible without carrying; Spells still require learning and Sigils.

Black Mirror.name: Unwelcome Reflection
Black Mirror.effect: Lose 2 Courage.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: The Coward in Glass
Black Mirror.effect: Lose 1 Courage for each different Sigil color you currently possess (maximum 3).
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: A Face Without Eyes
Black Mirror.effect: Lose 2 Courage. Your movement allowance is reduced by 1 on your next turn (minimum 1).
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: Echo of Panic
Black Mirror.effect: Lose 3 Courage unless you have a Companion present with you.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: Borrowed Terror
Black Mirror.effect: Lose 1 Courage and place a Dread marker on yourself; remove it after your next mandatory movement. While marked, you cannot gain bonus movement.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: Shattered Nerve
Black Mirror.effect: Lose 3 Courage. You cannot receive a protective Courage refund from a card during this curse.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: Occuldor’s Smile
Black Mirror.effect: Lose 4 Courage; if this would reduce you to 0, resolve the fragment restoration first.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: Empty Pockets
Black Mirror.effect: Leave 1 carried Element of your choice in this room.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: Cracked Satchel
Black Mirror.effect: Leave 1 carried Item of your choice in this room; its ongoing effect ends when you leave.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: Stolen Color
Black Mirror.effect: Choose one Element type you carry. Leave all your tokens of that type in this room (maximum 2).
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: The Unpacking
Black Mirror.effect: Choose up to 2 carried objects (Elements, Mirrors or Items) and leave them in the room; if you have fewer, leave what you can.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: False Weight
Black Mirror.effect: Until the end of your next turn, your Element capacity is 1 lower (minimum 1). Place excess Elements in this room.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: Fractured Case
Black Mirror.effect: If carrying a White or Black Mirror, leave one in this room; otherwise lose 2 Courage.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: The Price of Vanity
Black Mirror.effect: Choose: leave one Tool or Equipment in this room, or lose 3 Courage.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: Backwards Passage
Black Mirror.effect: After the collision, move to an adjacent connected room of your choice; this is forced movement, not your mandatory move.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: Hallway of Doubles
Black Mirror.effect: After the collision, return to the last room you occupied before entering this one, if reachable; otherwise lose 1 Courage.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: Twisted Step
Black Mirror.effect: Your next mandatory movement must end in a room you have previously visited, if legally reachable.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: Distant Reflection
Black Mirror.effect: After the collision, move to the nearest discovered room containing an Element; if tied, choose.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: Doors Remember
Black Mirror.effect: Choose one connection from your current room. You may not use that connection on your next turn.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: Lost Direction
Black Mirror.effect: On your next turn, move exactly your normal movement allowance if possible instead of up to it.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: Mirror Spiral
Black Mirror.effect: After the collision, move to any discovered room sharing a connection with the central Hall; if none exists, lose 2 Courage.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: Frightened Familiar
Black Mirror.effect: One of your Follower Companions (your choice) stays in this room until recruited again. If none, lose 1 Courage.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: Faded Incantation
Black Mirror.effect: One Quick Sigil assigned to a Spell you control becomes exhausted until your next turn. If none, lose 1 Courage.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: Muted Words
Black Mirror.effect: Choose one of your learned Spells. You cannot Quick-cast it on your next turn.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: Strange Appetite
Black Mirror.effect: One Companion with you cannot grant its positive ability during your next turn. If none, lose 2 Courage.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: Cold Binding
Black Mirror.effect: One Permanent Spell you control is suppressed until the end of your next turn; its bound Sigils remain attached. If none, lose 2 Courage.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: The Broken Chant
Black Mirror.effect: Until your next turn, the first Quick Spell you cast requires exhausting one additional available matching Sigil (if none, you cannot cast that Spell).
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: Haunting Silence
Black Mirror.effect: Choose two different learned Spells, if able. Neither can be Quick-cast on your next turn.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: A Door Turns Pale
Black Mirror.effect: After the collision, mark one connection touching this room. It is closed until the beginning of your next turn.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: The Lights Die
Black Mirror.effect: Place a Darkness marker on this room. The next hero to enter it removes the marker and must end movement there; no Courage loss is dealt by this curse.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: Wandering Stair
Black Mirror.effect: Move one neutral stair marker to a different legal room connection; that connection is a shortcut until the next collision.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: False Sanctuary
Black Mirror.effect: Place a Distortion marker in this room. The next discovered Companion cannot be recruited from this room until someone leaves and re-enters it.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: Broken Corridor
Black Mirror.effect: Select one connection on the castle map. Close it until another fragment is restored; players may use other legal paths.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: Occuldor’s Echo
Black Mirror.effect: Place an Echo marker on this room. The next Black Mirror flipped here forces its flipper to lose 1 additional Courage, then remove Echo.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Black Mirror.name: Restless Manor
Black Mirror.effect: Place one Haunting marker on any explored room. The first hero who chooses to use its local inventory must lose 1 Courage or ignore those objects this turn; then discard Haunting.
Black Mirror.cost: Flip an unblocked Black Mirror; only the flipping hero resolves this card.

Item.name: Element Bandolier
Item.cost: No learning cost. Access in your room or carry within Item/Relic limits.
Item.effect: Your carried Element capacity increases by 1.
Item.notes: Room access grants the increase only while present.

Item.name: Double-Pocket Satchel
Item.cost: No learning cost. Access in your room or carry within Item/Relic limits.
Item.effect: Your Equipment/Tool carrying capacity increases by 1.
Item.notes: Cannot use its own bonus to remove itself while over capacity.

Item.name: Mirror Harness
Item.cost: No learning cost. Access in your room or carry within Item/Relic limits.
Item.effect: Your carried Mirror capacity increases by 1.
Item.notes: White and Black Mirrors share this capacity.

Item.name: Swiftstep Boots
Item.cost: No learning cost. Access in your room or carry within Item/Relic limits.
Item.effect: Gain +1 maximum movement on each mandatory move.
Item.notes: Movement still mandatory.

Item.name: Traveler’s Lantern
Item.cost: No learning cost. Access in your room or carry within Item/Relic limits.
Item.effect: The first Courage loss from Occuldor entering your room each round is reduced by 1.
Item.notes: No effect against Black Mirror curses.

Item.name: Reflective Mantle
Item.cost: No learning cost. Access in your room or carry within Item/Relic limits.
Item.effect: Once per turn, reduce Courage lost from your Black Mirror curse by 1.
Item.notes: Cannot reduce unrelated Occuldor arrival punishment.

Item.name: Lockable Mirror Case
Item.cost: No learning cost. Access in your room or carry within Item/Relic limits.
Item.effect: Black Mirror curses cannot force you to leave carried Mirror cards in a room.
Item.notes: Does not stop voluntary trading.

Item.name: Interchange Pouch
Item.cost: No learning cost. Access in your room or carry within Item/Relic limits.
Item.effect: Once per turn, exchange 1 carried Element for 1 different Element present in your room without counting an additional action.
Item.notes: No Element is created.

Item.name: Corridor Chalk
Item.cost: No learning cost. Access in your room or carry within Item/Relic limits.
Item.effect: Once during your mandatory movement, treat one already-explored adjacent room as a legal transit room even if one temporary Darkness restriction applies.
Item.notes: Does not bypass hard-closed connections.

Item.name: Portable Writing Desk
Item.cost: No learning cost. Access in your room or carry within Item/Relic limits.
Item.effect: You may learn a Spell in your current room before or after movement when its requirements are available.
Item.notes: Learning still pays all Elements and uses a knowledge slot.

Item.name: Prism Lens
Item.cost: No learning cost. Access in your room or carry within Item/Relic limits.
Item.effect: Once per turn, look privately at one face-down Black Mirror in your room; return it face-down.
Item.notes: Spell requirement: Chromomancy / mirror foresight.

Item.name: Astrolabe
Item.cost: No learning cost. Access in your room or carry within Item/Relic limits.
Item.effect: Once per turn, inspect the color of one unexplored room adjacent to your current room; do not explore it.
Item.notes: Spell requirement: Astromancy.

Item.name: Cryptex
Item.cost: No learning cost. Access in your room or carry within Item/Relic limits.
Item.effect: Once per turn, you may exchange one Secret in your hand for the top Secret of the deck, keeping the new card private.
Item.notes: Spell requirement: Cryptomancy; old Secret is discarded.

Item.name: Chronoscope
Item.cost: No learning cost. Access in your room or carry within Item/Relic limits.
Item.effect: Once per round, treat your movement allowance as 1 higher or lower (minimum 1).
Item.notes: Spell requirement: Chronomancy.

Item.name: Necronomicon
Item.cost: No learning cost. Access in your room or carry within Item/Relic limits.
Item.effect: When entering a room with a Ghost Companion, you may resolve its beneficial entry effect once even if not recruited.
Item.notes: Spell requirement: Necromancy.

Item.name: Phonograph
Item.cost: No learning cost. Access in your room or carry within Item/Relic limits.
Item.effect: Once per turn, cancel a non-Courage movement restriction caused by one Companion in your room.
Item.notes: Spell requirement: Phonomancy.

Item.name: Florist’s Shears
Item.cost: No learning cost. Access in your room or carry within Item/Relic limits.
Item.effect: A Plant Companion in your room may be treated as a Follower until your next move ends.
Item.notes: Spell requirement: Floramancy.

Item.name: Geode Compass
Item.cost: No learning cost. Access in your room or carry within Item/Relic limits.
Item.effect: Once per turn, exchange one Earth Element for any one Element present in the same room.
Item.notes: Spell requirement: Geomancy; no token creation.

Item.name: Psychograph
Item.cost: No learning cost. Access in your room or carry within Item/Relic limits.
Item.effect: Once per round, treat yourself as one Fear tier higher for the purpose of a Spell’s condition (not for Courage or movement).
Item.notes: Spell requirement: Psychomancy.

Item.name: Ring of Steady Light
Item.cost: No learning cost. Access in your room or carry within Item/Relic limits.
Item.effect: The first point of Courage you lose on your own turn each round is prevented.
Item.notes: Does not reduce Occuldor arrival loss on another turn.

Item.name: Pendant of the Third Eye
Item.cost: No learning cost. Access in your room or carry within Item/Relic limits.
Item.effect: Once each round, after you place a Mirror pair, you may look at the face-down Black Mirror in that room.
Item.notes: You may not reveal it to others.

Item.name: Brooch of Passage
Item.cost: No learning cost. Access in your room or carry within Item/Relic limits.
Item.effect: When starting movement at Courage 7 or lower, you may move up to 2 rooms regardless of your current tier allowance.
Item.notes: Does not prevent paralysis.

Item.name: Crown Shard of Resolve
Item.cost: No learning cost. Access in your room or carry within Item/Relic limits.
Item.effect: Whenever you restore a fragment whose placement has zero same-color neighbors, gain +1 Courage.
Item.notes: Once per restored fragment; no stacking from multiple Relics.

Item.name: Amulet of Unbinding
Item.cost: No learning cost. Access in your room or carry within Item/Relic limits.
Item.effect: The first time each game you abandon a Spell with Permanent Sigils, recover one bound Sigil to your exhausted supply instead of discarding it.
Item.notes: Sigil cannot activate again until refreshed.

Item.name: Locket of the Drunken Pony
Item.cost: No learning cost. Access in your room or carry within Item/Relic limits.
Item.effect: Your first Companion conflict each round may be ignored; both Companions remain.
Item.notes: Characters still follow their own timing rules.

casting_modes.effect: After revealing your Black Mirror curse, reduce its Courage loss by 1.

Spell.name: Rippling Step

casting_modes.name: Quick
casting_modes.assignment: Temporary; exhaust all matching Sigils, refresh per agreed timing.
casting_modes.effect: After mandatory movement, move one additional connected room (you may enter it).
